decisions.reason: The automatic de-shuttering robot is a core module of the firm's automated circulation plants, and the engineering already sunk into it is substantial, so weak demand from the construction downturn is read as temporary and the firm stays committed.

The profile storage robot complements the shuttering and de-shuttering robots in integrated lines, and dropping it would undercut the firm's publicly announced full-automation offering, so it is kept despite modest stand-alone sales.

The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's future-ready precast automation direction, and after withdrawing the combined robot, management has even more reason to justify and concentrate on the dedicated shuttering robot.

The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine is a freshly launched multi-model product line, so investment and visible commitment are high and any early weak results are put down to long investment cycles in precast plants.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, supports the digital and uptime promise of the firm's lifecycle offering, and is still too new for disappointing results to prompt withdrawal.
